title: Search a valid username and view the profile and repositories
description: This test verifies that a visitor can search for a valid GitHub username from the empty state and see the loaded profile card and recent repositories.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify an empty search state is visible
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a loading indicator is displayed

title: Show an empty input error after submitting without a username
description: This test verifies that submitting the search form with no username shows an inline validation error and leaves the app ready for correction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Submit the search form without entering a username
Verify an inline validation error is visible
Fill in the search field with a username
Verify the inline validation error clears while typing

title: Find a GitHub user from the empty state
description: This test verifies that a valid username search from the empty state loads the profile card and recent repositories section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a user profile card is displayed
Verify a recent repositories section is displayed

title: Block empty search submission with validation
description: This test verifies that submitting an empty search shows a missing-input validation message and keeps the user on the search state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Submit the search form
Verify an inline validation message is visible for missing input

title: Return to the empty state after a failed search
description: This test verifies that the retry or reset control returns the app from an error state back to the initial empty state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a non-existent GitHub username
Submit the search form
Choose to try again
Verify the empty state is displayed
Verify the search field is ready for a new username

title: Submit a username by pressing Enter
description: This test verifies that a visitor can search for a valid GitHub username using the keyboard and see the app begin loading the request.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Press Enter
Verify a loading indicator is displayed

title: Show a not-found error for an unknown username
description: This test verifies that searching for a username that does not exist shows a not-found error state instead of profile results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a non-existent GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a user-not-found error is visible
Verify profile results are not displayed

title: View the full profile card for a valid user
description: This test verifies that a successful search displays the user profile card with avatar, username, display name, bio, location, and stats.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the user profile card is displayed
Verify profile details and stats are displayed

title: Reset from not-found back to the empty search state
description: This test verifies that after a not-found result, the user can retry or reset and return to the idle search state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a clearly non-existent GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a user-not-found error message is visible
Click the retry or reset control
Verify the empty search state is visible

title: Show up to six recent repositories for a valid user
description: This test verifies that the recent repositories section displays a repository grid with no more than six items for a successfully searched user.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the recent repositories section is displayed
Verify up to six repositories are displayed

title: Show a fallback when the user has no public repositories
description: This test verifies that the repositories section shows a fallback message when the searched user has no public repositories.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username with no public repositories
Submit the search form
Verify the recent repositories section is displayed
Verify an empty repositories fallback message is visible

title: Search again after a prior successful lookup
description: This test verifies that searching for a different username after a successful lookup replaces the previous results with the new user's profile and repositories.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Fill in the search field with another valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a user profile card is displayed for the new search
Verify a recent repositories section is displayed for the new search

title: Search a new username after a successful lookup
description: This test verifies that after viewing one user's results, the visitor can search for another username and see the new profile results replace the previous ones.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the user profile card is displayed
Fill in the search field with a different valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the new user profile card is displayed

title: Clear the empty-search validation while typing
description: This test verifies that after an empty-submit validation error, typing a username again clears the validation state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Submit the search form
Verify an inline validation message is visible for missing input
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Verify the validation message is cleared

title: Open the GitHub profile from the results view
description: This test verifies that the user can open the searched GitHub profile link from the loaded results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the user profile card is displayed
Click the GitHub profile link
Verify the profile link opens in a new tab or window

title: Show loading before results appear for a username search
description: This test verifies that submitting a username search shows a loading state before the profile and repository results are rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify a loading state is visible
Verify the loading state is replaced by search results

title: Open a repository from the results in a new tab
description: This test verifies that a repository link in the recent repositories section opens in a new tab or window.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the search field with a valid GitHub username
Submit the search form
Verify the recent repositories section is displayed
Click a repository link
Verify the repository link opens in a new tab or window
